title: 海岸濕地復育水理~Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration
focus: 潮汐連通、淹水歷時、泥砂高程與適應性監測~Tidal connectivity, hydroperiod, sediment elevation and adaptive monitoring
summary: 以Nisqually河口與南灣鹽田復育為背景，逐步理解濕地工程如何連結水位、潮溝、泥砂及棲地。十個原創單元從潮汐容積、淹水歷時和通道延遲，延伸至植生阻力、蒸發濃縮、有效沖洗及前後對照，所有公式都說明適用假設與需補充的觀測。~Using Nisqually estuary and South Bay salt-pond restoration as context, connect water levels, channels, sediment and habitat. Ten original units progress from prism, hydroperiod and tidal lag to vegetation drag, evaporation, effective flushing and controlled before-after comparison, stating assumptions and additional observations for every model.
history: Nisqually河口在2009年移除舊Brown Farm堤防後恢復潮汐影響，官方紀錄強調合作與後續監測。南灣鹽田復育計畫於2003年啟動，2007年完成長期規劃，2009年開始第一期施工，顯示復育是分階段學習與調整的過程。這些案例的地形、潮汐與生態條件不同，不能套用相同開口或植生設定。本課以獨立教學算例練習水量、鹽量和泥砂守恆，再比較地表高程與海面變化，讓工程完成與生態成效驗證成為可分別檢查的問題。~Nisqually restored tidal influence after removal of the old Brown Farm Dike in 2009, with official records emphasizing partnership and subsequent monitoring. South Bay restoration launched in 2003, completed long-term planning in 2007 and began Phase 1 construction in 2009, illustrating staged learning and adjustment. Different terrain, tides and ecological conditions prevent direct transfer of openings or vegetation assumptions. Independent teaching examples examine water, salt and sediment conservation and compare surface elevation with sea level, separating construction completion from evidence of ecological response.
example: 教學假設固定儲水面積100000 m²、內部潮差1.0 m，得到每次漲潮容積100000 m³，但不能把它全部當成永久新水替換。另一個固定水量200000 m³的混合模型，每潮有效替換5%，十潮後仍有約59.87%舊水；這說明總交換量和有效沖洗不同。再假設每年淤積5 mm、淺層壓密1.5 mm，地表只升高3.5 mm；若同基準海面升高6 mm，濕地相對海面仍每年下降2.5 mm。請將這些獨立算例分開記帳，逐項改變參數，並用潮位、示蹤與高程資料檢查能否支持模型。~Assume constant storage area 100000 m² and internal tidal range 1.0 m, giving 100000 m³ per flood tide, but not necessarily that amount of permanent new-water replacement. In a separate 200000 m³ mixed-volume model with 5% effective replacement per tide, about 59.87% old water remains after ten tides. Gross exchange and effective flushing differ. Separately, accretion of 5 mm/year and shallow compaction of 1.5 mm/year yield surface gain of 3.5 mm/year; against sea-level rise of 6 mm/year on the same datum, relative elevation declines 2.5 mm/year. Keep these scenarios distinct, vary their parameters and identify tidal, tracer and elevation observations that test each assumption.
facts: 本課10個單元連結水理、泥砂與成效監測。~The 10 units connect hydraulics, sediment and response monitoring.
教學潮汐容積100000 m³不等於淨沖洗量。~The teaching tidal prism of 100000 m³ is not net flushing.
教學正弦潮使0.50 m平台每週期淹水4.14 h。~The teaching sinusoidal tide inundates the 0.50 m platform for 4.14 hours per cycle.
教學保留1500 kg泥砂形成0.25 mm未壓密沉積。~The teaching 1500 kg retained sediment yields 0.25 mm deposition before compaction.
教學地表相對海面每年下降2.5 mm。~Teaching surface elevation falls 2.5 mm/year relative to the sea.
教學差中之差15個百分點不自動代表統計顯著。~The teaching contrast of 15 percentage points does not automatically establish significance.

units.anchor: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線~Tidal prism and elevation-area curves
units.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線~Tidal prism and elevation-area curves
units.mechanism: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。潮汐容積可由不同水位間的面積積分得到，低灘、高灘和潮溝對體積的貢獻不同。若通道阻力使內部水位追不上外海潮位，外海潮差也不能直接套入濕地儲量曲線。教學先使用固定平面面積建立量綱概念，再要求以高程面積曲線和內外水位資料檢查簡化，避免把理想交換量當成實際淨沖洗量。~After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. Integrating inundated area between water levels gives tidal prism, with channels and marsh elevations contributing differently. If resistance prevents internal levels from tracking the sea, offshore tidal range cannot be applied directly to wetland storage. Begin with constant plan area, then examine elevation-area curves and internal levels, keeping gross tidal exchange distinct from net flushing of old water.
units.model: 教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。這是每次漲潮的體積增量，不是整日淨入流。~Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Tidal prism is 100000 m³ per flood tide, not a daily net inflow.
units.verify: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。核對潮溝和高灘是否在該水位範圍真正被淹，另以流量時間積分檢查一個完整潮週期的入出水量，保留降雨與河川流入的影響。~Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Check which channels and platforms are actually inundated, then compare integrated flow over a complete tidal cycle while accounting separately for rainfall and river inflow.
units.failure: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。把漲潮容積再當成淨淡水補充，則忽略退潮排出與舊水返回，容易高估沖洗和水質改善。~Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Treating flood-tide prism as net freshwater supply further ignores ebb discharge and returning old water, exaggerating flushing and potential quality improvement.
units.misconception: 濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。~Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
units.practice: 建立兩段高程面積曲線，讓低水位時只有潮溝存水，高水位時才淹過平台。用分段積分重算潮汐容積，再降低內部潮差，說明地形與水力限制如何分別改變交換量，並列出需要的觀測資料。~Create a two-part area curve with channel-only storage at low levels and platform inundation higher up. Integrate the prism, reduce internal tidal range separately, and explain how terrain and hydraulic restrictions affect exchange and what observations distinguish them.

units.anchor: 淹水歷時與棲地高程~Inundation duration and habitat elevation
units.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程~Inundation duration and habitat elevation
units.mechanism: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。理想正弦潮可用來推導某平台高程被淹的時間比例，但真實潮汐包含多個分量、風暴增水及河川作用，不能用一天代表全年。復育評估應讓地形高程和水位使用相同基準，並同時檢查長時間積水及極端乾燥情境。課程算例只描述水理，不把某個淹水比例直接當成所有物種都適合的生態門檻。~Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. A sinusoidal tide can estimate the time a platform is submerged, but real tides combine multiple constituents, surges and river effects, so one day cannot represent a year. Align terrain and water-level datums and consider both persistent flooding and drying. The teaching calculation describes hydraulics without treating one hydroperiod fraction as a universal ecological suitability threshold.
units.model: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。~For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.
units.verify: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。用實際時序逐點統計淹水時間，檢查取樣間隔及缺值，再將春潮、小潮與季節期間分列，不用理想單一週期取代長期觀測。~Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Calculate duration directly from observed time series, review sampling and missing data, and separate spring, neap and seasonal periods rather than replacing long-term behavior with one idealized cycle.
units.failure: 地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。若只量高潮水位而不記錄時間，也無法分辨短暫越淹與長時間積水，可能使棲地判讀失去關鍵資訊。~A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. Recording only high water cannot distinguish brief inundation from persistent ponding, removing information essential to interpreting habitat conditions and restoration response.
units.misconception: 兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。~Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
units.practice: 將平台高程改為0.25 m，重算理想淹水比例和時數。再加入固定增水0.20 m，區分地形下降與平均水位上升造成的相似效果，並說明需要哪些基準量測才能辨別兩種成因。~Lower the platform to 0.25 m and recalculate fraction and duration. Add a separate 0.20 m mean-water increase, distinguish similar effects of terrain lowering and water-level rise, and identify datum observations needed to separate these causes.

units.anchor: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲~Channel resistance and tidal lag
units.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲~Channel resistance and tidal lag
units.mechanism: 濕地與外海之間的連通通道會限制流量，使內部水位振幅減小並落後外部潮位。線性集總儲水模型把通道流量近似為內外水位差的比例，配合儲量守恆得到一階低通反應。這種模型假設面積與通水能力固定，適合說明時間尺度，卻不能描述閘門切換、乾濕交替或高速非線性流動。判讀復育後的水位時，應同時看振幅和相位，不只以最高水位接近外海就認為整個潮週期交換完全恢復。~A connecting channel limits flow, attenuating internal tidal amplitude and delaying the wetland response. A linear lumped-storage model makes flow proportional to the external-internal level difference, producing a first-order low-pass response through conservation. Constant area and conductance simplify timescales but cannot describe gate switching, wetting-drying or strongly nonlinear flow. Examine amplitude and phase together rather than assuming full tidal exchange is restored merely because the internal high-water mark approaches the sea level.
units.model: 教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h；振幅比R=1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]約0.703，相位落後atan(2π×2/12.42)約0.791 rad。~For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians.
units.verify: 將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。檢查不同潮差下的反應是否仍近似線性，若高低潮時殘差系統性改變，應調查面積變化、乾濕邊界或通道非線性。~Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units. Evaluate whether responses remain linear across ranges; systematic residuals near high or low water should prompt investigation of changing area, wetting-drying or nonlinear channel behavior.
units.failure: 只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。儀器時鐘偏差也會產生假的相位落後；若把兩者混淆，可能錯判通道阻力或復育後的水力連通改善。~Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale. Instrument clock offsets also create false phase lag, potentially leading to mistaken conclusions about channel resistance or improved hydraulic connectivity following restoration.
units.misconception: 內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。~Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
units.practice: 將時間常數減半，重算振幅比與相位，再將週期改成原來兩倍。比較通道改善與潮汐頻率改變的不同情境，並列出需要由觀測支持的固定面積、線性通水能力及時間同步假設。~Halve the time constant and recalculate amplitude and phase, then double tidal period separately. Compare channel improvement with changed forcing frequency and list observations needed to support constant area, linear conductance and synchronized timing assumptions.

units.anchor: 連通開口與差水頭流量~Connecting openings and differential-head flow
units.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量~Connecting openings and differential-head flow
units.mechanism: 兩側都淹沒的連通開口可用差水頭孔口式作初步教學估算，流量與開口面積成正比、與差水頭平方根成正比。係數概括收縮與能量損失，不能把任意數值直接當成現地設備的校正值。潮汐會使差水頭方向改變，流量符號也需要跟著變；如果一側露出水面，原先的淹沒孔口條件可能失效。濕地復育還要兼顧泥砂、漂流物與生態通行，單一流量公式不能決定實際開口尺寸或施工方式。~A submerged connection can be illustrated with a differential-head orifice relation: discharge scales with opening area and the square root of head difference. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses, not an arbitrary field calibration. Tides reverse the head difference and flow direction, while exposure of one side can invalidate submerged-flow assumptions. Sediment, debris and ecological passage also matter, so a single discharge equation cannot determine a restoration opening size or construction approach.
units.model: 教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m；Q=0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s，方向由高水頭流向低水頭。~Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m. Discharge is 0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s, directed from higher to lower head.
units.verify: 同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。以正負號表示流向，檢查接近零差水頭與退潮露出的時段，對不符合淹沒條件的資料另行分類，不用同一係數硬套所有流況。~Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth. Track flow sign and classify near-zero or exposed conditions separately instead of forcing one coefficient across regimes that do not meet the submerged-flow assumptions.
units.failure: 把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。忽略潮汐反向則會把整個週期的往返水量都算成單向淨輸送，破壞水量守恆。~Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels. Ignoring reversal counts back-and-forth tidal movement as unidirectional transport and breaks the cycle water balance.
units.misconception: 兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。~A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
units.practice: 將差水頭降為原值四分之一，保持面積和係數不變，重算流量並比較比例。再交換兩側水位，標出流向改變，最後說明當一側出露或開口堵塞時，哪些假設需要重新檢查。~Reduce head difference to one quarter at unchanged area and coefficient, then compare discharge ratios. Swap the levels to show reversal and identify assumptions requiring review when one side emerges or the opening becomes partially blocked.

units.anchor: 泥砂質量與平台淤積~Sediment mass and platform accretion
units.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積~Sediment mass and platform accretion
units.mechanism: 進入濕地的懸浮泥砂只有部分會留在平台，其餘可能隨退潮排出或在潮溝重新懸浮。由水量與濃度估算進入質量後，還需要保留比例和乾體積密度才能換算沉積體積與厚度。這個換算不等於地表高程的最終增加，因為壓密、侵蝕與有機物變化也會影響高程。復育監測應同時採集流量、濃度、地形重測與沉積層資料，讓短期泥砂通量與長期平台變化能互相檢驗，而非只依一場濁水事件推論長期成長。~Only part of incoming suspended sediment remains on a wetland platform; the rest can leave on ebb tides or be resuspended. Convert water volume and concentration to incoming mass, then apply a retained fraction and dry bulk density to estimate deposited volume and thickness. Deposition is not identical to final elevation gain because compaction, erosion and organic processes also contribute. Combine flow and concentration observations with repeat surveys and sediment records rather than extrapolating one turbid event into a long-term growth trajectory.
units.model: 教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²；保留1500 kg，沉積2.5 m³，厚度0.25 mm，未扣壓密。~Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m². Retained mass is 1500 kg, volume 2.5 m³ and thickness 0.25 mm before compaction.
units.verify: 分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。以乾重定義檢查體積密度，再與沉積標誌層和高程重測比較，將沉積厚度與地表高程變化分欄，不以兩者相似就省略壓密檢查。~Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation. Verify dry bulk-density definitions, compare marker horizons with repeat elevations, and retain separate deposition and elevation-change records rather than assuming compaction is negligible because two values appear similar.
units.failure: 使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。若只量漲潮進砂而不量退潮出砂，也會高估保留率，讓平台淤積預測偏高且缺乏閉合的質量證據。~Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume. Measuring only incoming flood-tide sediment overstates retention when ebb export is ignored, producing an optimistic accretion estimate without a closed sediment mass balance.
units.misconception: 漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。~All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
units.practice: 將保留率改成10%，重算沉積厚度；再保持質量不變但把乾體積密度加倍，比較結果。說明泥砂供應、保留效率與壓密如何造成不同變化，並設計能區分三者的量測表。~Lower retention to 10% and recalculate thickness, then double dry bulk density at fixed mass. Compare sediment supply, retention and compaction as distinct causes of change, and design observations that distinguish their contributions.

units.anchor: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面~Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level
units.title: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面~Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level
units.mechanism: 濕地表面累積沉積物，不代表相對海面的高程一定增加。淺層壓密、根系生長與深部地層移動會使沉積厚度和地表高程變化不同，而海面上升又改變相對位置。比較時必須讓地表與潮位的參考基準一致，避免把深部沉降重複扣除。教學以明確基準下的簡單速率帳說明差異，並強調長期速率可能隨泥砂供應和植生回饋而改變，不能把短期測得的常數延伸成確定的數十年預測。~Sediment accumulation does not guarantee elevation gain relative to the sea. Shallow compaction, root processes and deeper movement separate accretion from surface elevation change, while rising water alters relative position. Use consistent reference frames and avoid subtracting deep subsidence twice. A clearly defined rate balance illustrates these distinctions, but sediment supply and vegetation feedback can change rates over time, so short-term constants should not be presented as certain multidecade forecasts of wetland persistence.
units.model: 教學假設相對同一深基準的淤積5 mm/year、淺層壓密1.5 mm/year，其他地表項為零；地表升高3.5 mm/year。海面相對同基準升6 mm/year，濕地相對海面下降2.5 mm/year；20年線性情境為50 mm。~Relative to one deep benchmark, assume accretion 5 mm/year, shallow compaction 1.5 mm/year and no other surface terms. Surface gain is 3.5 mm/year against sea-level rise 6 mm/year, a relative deficit of 2.5 mm/year or 50 mm over a linear 20-year scenario.
units.verify: 畫出沉積標誌層、地表量測基準與潮位基準之間的關係，確認每項速率描述的是哪個相對位移。比較不同期間的速率與不確定度，將線性情境標成假設而非預報，並檢查是否已在相對海面資料中包含深部地層移動。~Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate. Compare periods and uncertainties, label linear projections as scenarios, and check whether deep movement is already embedded in the relative sea-level record before applying another correction.
units.failure: 只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。把已含沉降的相對海面速率再扣一次沉降，也會誇大高程赤字，使比較失去共同基準。~Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted. Subtracting subsidence already included in relative sea level double-counts it and exaggerates the elevation deficit.
units.misconception: 只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。~Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
units.practice: 將淤積率提高到7 mm/year，其他條件不變，重算相對高程速率。另設海面加速上升的情境，說明為何固定速率乘年數不再適用，並列出需要持續更新的沉積、壓密與潮位觀測。~Increase accretion to 7 mm/year with other terms unchanged and recalculate relative elevation change. Introduce accelerating sea level separately, explain why rate-times-duration no longer applies, and list the deposition, compaction and tidal observations requiring continued updates.

units.anchor: 植生阻力與流速敏感度~Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity
units.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度~Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity
units.mechanism: 濕地植生會改變水流阻力、沉積與波動，但植株不是固定粗糙度常數。莖徑、密度、高度、彎曲和淹沒程度都會改變有效迎流面積，強流時倒伏又可能降低阻力。理想直立剛性圓柱陣列的阻力式可用來理解流速平方關係，卻不能直接代表真實混合植群或極端風浪。復育分析應區分植生對平均流、波浪與生態條件的作用，並用季節及水深不同的觀測檢查假設，不以種植面積直接保證特定防洪成效。~Vegetation modifies flow resistance, deposition and waves, but plants are not fixed roughness constants. Stem dimensions, density, height, bending and submergence change frontal area, while reconfiguration in strong flow can reduce drag. An ideal array of upright rigid stems illustrates quadratic velocity dependence without representing mixed vegetation or extreme waves. Distinguish effects on mean flow, waves and habitat, and examine seasonal and depth-dependent evidence rather than promising a specific flood benefit from planted area alone.
units.model: 教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s；每床面積阻力F/A=0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa。~Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s. Drag per bed area is 0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa.
units.verify: 確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。檢查淹水深是否超過植株高度，並比較不同流速下的姿態和阻力，若植株明顯彎曲，需重新定義有效面積，不能只調整係數來掩蓋幾何改變。~Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover. Check depth against plant height and compare posture across velocities; substantial bending requires reassessing effective area instead of merely adjusting a coefficient to conceal geometric change.
units.failure: 把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。假設所有植株在強流中保持直立，也可能高估阻力與衰減作用，讓植生方案看起來比實際更有效。~Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error. Assuming all plants remain upright under strong currents can overstate drag and attenuation, making an intervention appear more effective than the supporting physical evidence warrants.
units.misconception: 植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。~Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
units.practice: 把流速加倍，在剛性假設下重算阻力，再假設有效迎流面積因彎曲減半，比較兩結果。說明為何流速敏感度與植株形變必須一起考慮，並提出能觀察季節和淹沒程度差異的資料欄位。~Double velocity under rigid assumptions, then halve effective frontal area to represent hypothetical bending. Compare drag, explain the interaction between velocity sensitivity and reconfiguration, and propose observations resolving seasonal and submergence differences.

units.anchor: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆~Evaporative concentration and salt balance
units.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆~Evaporative concentration and salt balance
units.mechanism: 連通受限的濕地或舊鹽田可能在蒸發時失去水分而保留鹽分，使濃度升高。簡化鹽量帳假設鹽不揮發、沒有析出或其他進出流，適合說明水量與鹽量守恆的差別，但真實濕地還有潮汐交換、降雨、地下水和植生作用。用鹽度判讀水力連通時，應同時知道水量變化，因為濃度升高不一定代表新增海水輸入。課程的理想濃縮計算不提供生態適宜濃度，而是訓練學徒列出所有可能的水與鹽路徑。~A poorly connected wetland or former salt pond can lose water through evaporation while retaining salt, increasing concentration. A simple balance assumes nonvolatile salt, no precipitation and no other flows, illustrating the difference between water and salt conservation. Real wetlands also exchange tidal water, rain and groundwater. Interpret salinity with volume changes because increasing concentration need not indicate additional seawater input. The calculation sets no ecological suitability threshold; it trains learners to identify separate water and salt pathways.
units.model: 教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出；剩水9000 m³，濃度200000/9000=22.22 kg/m³，採體積可直接相減近似。~Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation. Remaining volume is 9000 m³ and concentration 22.22 kg/m³ under the stated volume approximation.
units.verify: 分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。同步記錄降雨、蒸發與潮汐交換，若出現結晶或地下交換，應新增相應項目而非強迫簡式閉合。~Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical. Track rain, evaporation and tidal exchange concurrently, adding terms for crystallization or groundwater exchange when present rather than forcing the simplified balance to close.
units.failure: 只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。反過來，若有鹽析出卻仍假設全部溶解，會高估水中濃度；水量與鹽相態資料必須一起支持解釋。~Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation. Assuming all salt remains dissolved when precipitation occurs overstates aqueous concentration, so volume and salt-phase evidence must jointly support the interpretation.
units.misconception: 水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。~Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
units.practice: 在蒸發後加入1000 m³無鹽雨水，重算水量與鹽濃度，再與加入同體積含鹽潮水比較。說明相同水位回升為何可能伴隨不同鹽度，並列出辨識來源所需的水量與濃度觀測。~After evaporation, add 1000 m³ of salt-free rain and recalculate concentration, then compare with the same volume of saline tidal water. Explain why equal level recovery can accompany different salinity and identify the flow and concentration observations needed to distinguish sources.

units.anchor: 往返潮水與有效沖洗~Returning tidal water and effective flushing
units.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗~Returning tidal water and effective flushing
units.mechanism: 潮汐進出的總量不等於每次都換入全新水體，退潮排出的舊水可能在下一次漲潮返回。簡化離散混合模型可用有效替換比例描述每個週期後舊水剩餘量，但需要假設完全混合、固定容積及穩定替換率。潮溝捷徑、死水區和分層都會讓實際停留時間呈現分布，不能用一個平均值保證所有位置都被沖洗。復育後應以示蹤或多點時間序列檢驗交換效率，同時區分水體更新與污染物反應造成的濃度降低。~Gross tidal exchange does not replace the wetland with entirely new water each cycle, because ebb water can return on the next flood. A discrete mixed-volume model uses an effective replacement fraction to track old water, assuming complete mixing, fixed volume and a constant fraction. Short-circuiting, stagnant zones and stratification produce residence-time distributions rather than one universal duration. Test exchange with tracers or multiple time series and distinguish water renewal from concentration changes caused by reactions.
units.model: 教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05；每次完成完全混合替換後，十潮剩餘舊水比例(1−0.05)^10=0.5987。有效替換量不同於總潮汐容積。~Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05. Under complete discrete mixing, old-water fraction after ten tides is 0.95^10=0.5987; effective replacement differs from gross tidal prism.
units.verify: 先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。以多位置示蹤衰減比較同一模型，若尾端衰減很慢或不同位置差異大，應調查死水區與回流，不只用初期快速變化估計整片濕地沖洗能力。~Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one. Compare tracer decay at multiple locations; slow tails or spatial differences should prompt investigation of stagnant zones and return flow rather than extrapolation from rapid initial changes alone.
units.failure: 把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。只在通道附近採樣也可能看到快速更新，卻漏掉平台凹地的長停留水體，使平均模型掩蓋局部問題。~Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing. Sampling only near the channel can detect rapid renewal while missing long-residence water in depressions, allowing a mean model to conceal localized stagnant conditions.
units.misconception: 每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。~Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
units.practice: 將有效替換比例提高至0.10，重算十潮後舊水比例，並比較把比例直接乘十的錯誤線性估算。另畫一個不參與交換的死水區，指出完全混合假設如何失效，以及應增加哪些採樣位置。~Increase effective replacement to 0.10 and recalculate the ten-cycle fraction, comparing with the incorrect linear shortcut of multiplying by ten. Add a stagnant compartment, identify the failed mixing assumption and propose additional sampling locations.

units.anchor: 復育成效與前後對照~Restoration response and before-after controls
units.title: 復育成效與前後對照~Restoration response and before-after controls
units.mechanism: 工程完成後觀察到棲地或水理指標改善，仍需要辨認季節、區域氣候和其他工程同時變化的影響。前後與對照區比較可用來扣除共同背景變化，但對照區必須具有可比較性，且多個獨立樣區和時間點比大量重複量同一點更能支持推論。簡單差中之差只是描述指標變化，不自動證明因果或統計顯著。適應性管理應先定義目標、量測方法與調整條件，再依觀測更新假設，而不是在看到結果後才挑選最有利的指標。~An improved habitat or hydraulic indicator after construction may also reflect seasonality, regional climate or other interventions. Before-after comparison with a control can remove shared background change, but comparability and independent spatial-temporal replication matter. A simple difference-in-differences is descriptive rather than automatic proof of causality or statistical significance. Adaptive management should define objectives, measurements and decision conditions in advance, then revise hypotheses using evidence instead of selecting the most favorable indicator after results are known.
units.model: 教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%；差中之差為(50−30)−(45−40)=15個百分點，尚無樣本變異資料，不能宣稱統計顯著。~Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control. Difference-in-differences is 15 percentage points; without sampling variability, statistical significance cannot be claimed.
units.verify: 確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。保留獨立樣區及時間點的原始值，報告變異與缺測，再比較水理、泥砂及生態指標是否支持同一解釋，而非只保留改善最大的數字。~Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction. Retain independent plot and time observations, report variability and missingness, and compare hydraulic, sediment and ecological indicators rather than selecting only the largest improvement.
units.failure: 把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。沒有對照與變異資料就宣稱工程造成全部改善，也可能把共同氣候因素或觀測方法改變誤當成復育效果。~Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results. Attributing all improvement to construction without controls or variability can also mistake regional climate or changed observation methods for a restoration effect.
units.misconception: 復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。~Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
units.practice: 改成對照區也增加二十個百分點，重算差中之差並說明結論如何改變。再設計兩個獨立樣區與跨季節觀測表，列出可檢查共同趨勢的資料，以及仍不能由簡單差值直接證明的因果問題。~Let the control also improve by twenty percentage points and recompute the contrast. Design independent plots and seasonal observations, identify evidence for common trends, and explain which causal questions remain unresolved by the simple difference alone.
